description: This is a unit test class for the WorkScheduleService in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, specifically testing various scenarios of retrieving work schedule implementations, handling errors, and validating class adherence to interfaces.

classes.name: WorkScheduleServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the behavior of WorkScheduleService, including handling of missing or invalid work schedule classes, and correct instantiation of valid classes.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleInvalidClass
classes.description: A dummy class used for testing the scenario where the work schedule class does not implement the required interface.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleInvalidClassExceptionInConstructor
classes.description: A dummy class used to simulate a failure during instantiation of the work schedule class.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleValidClass
classes.description: A mock implementation of WorkScheduleInterface used for testing successful retrieval and behavior of a work schedule class.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test method runs.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleNotDefined
methods.description: Tests behavior when the work schedule implementation is not defined (null).

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleClassNotFound
methods.description: Tests behavior when the specified work schedule class does not exist.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleInvalidClass
methods.description: Tests behavior when the work schedule class does not implement the required interface.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleClassExceptionInConstructor
methods.description: Tests behavior when the work schedule class constructor throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetWorkSchedule
methods.description: Tests successful retrieval and instantiation of a valid work schedule class.
